title: Scroll-mode immersive header overlaps the first visible lines of text
symptom: In scroll mode, the persistent back arrow and chapter label visually collided with the top lines of正文.
root_cause: Scroll-mode content started at the very top of the viewport while the immersive header occupied the same visual band. Unlike page mode, scroll mode had no reserved top viewport inset.
fix: Added a dedicated top viewport inset for scroll mode.
Kept the immersive header lightweight while ensuring正文 never enters the header band.
impact: The first screen of text became harder to read and made the persistent header look visually broken.
